text: By the duality principle of category theory, reversing all arrows turns the notion of a product into that of a ___ (and terminal objects into initial ones).
explanation: Dualizing (reversing arrows and composition order) sends products to coproducts, monos to epis, and terminal objects to initial ones; the coproduct A + B carries injections and the dual universal property. In Set the coproduct is the disjoint union.
